Reference / time/date

time/date#

Immutable dates in the proleptic Gregorian calendar.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let release = Date(year: 2026, month: 8, day: 11);
release.weekday(); // Weekday.tuesday
let tomorrow = release.shifted(1);
DaysBetween(left: release, right: tomorrow).count(); // 1

Description#

Immutable dates in the proleptic Gregorian calendar.

Supported years are 1..9999. There is no year zero, implicit time zone or host calendar dependency. Date ordinals are one-based: 0001-01-01 is day 1 and Monday. DaysBetween(left: left, right: right) is signed and means right minus left.

object GregorianDay#

object GregorianDay

The day number of a date in the proleptic Gregorian calendar, counted from 0001-01-01 (day 1), and the date of a day number: the shared arithmetic representation of dates.
